title: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY):

items: is a government-backed pension scheme for senior citizens aged 60 and above, launched on May 4,
 Objective: To provide assured pension for 10 years.
 Pension Range: Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 10,000 per month.
 Policy Values: Minimum Rs. 1.5 lakh, Maximum Rs. 15 lakh.
 Pension Payment: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly.
 Loan Facility: 75% of the purchase price after 3 years.
 Tax Benefits: Premium is exempt under Section 80C, pension is taxable.
 Premature Exit: Available with certain conditions.
